P_calibration.quote: General federal aiding-and-abetting law (18 U.S.C. § 2) could still reach some conduct on the criminal side.
P_calibration.note: also: 'Note, however, that (B) is also the provision most likely to be used against workarounds like vessel-splitting (item 1).'

P_holdback.quote: Highlighting them before the markup may prompt technical corrections that tighten the bill. Counsel may want to separate the "unworkability" arguments to raise publicly (items 6, 9, 16, 26, 30, 34) from the "operating room" items to hold for post-enactment planning.

P_reliance_caveat.quote: Structuring around the thresholds or definitions carries exposure. The Sec. 2(1)(B) catch-all, anti-evasion doctrines, and 18 U.S.C. § 1001 (for registry certifications or environmental-assessment claims) could all be used against an aggressive structure.
